David Montgomery-August 18, 2026

According to this week's Economist / YouGov Poll, about one-third (35%) of Americans strongly or somewhat approve of Donald Trump's job performance as president, and 61% disapprove. That's a net job approval of -26, up slightly from -29 last week.

President Donald Trump’s approval rating has fallen to 33 percent in the latest Economist/YouGov poll, marking his lowest approval in YouGov tracking across both his first and second terms. The survey, conducted August 7–10, 2026, found that 62 percent of Americans disapprove of his job performance, giving Trump a net approval rating of -29, also the lowest he has ever recorded.
